# hookcase

Dependency-free Bun/TypeScript CLI for deterministic webhook fixture contracts.

- Site: https://vystartasv.github.io/hookcase/
- Source: https://github.com/vystartasv/hookcase
- Scope: fixture creation, checking, diffing, canonical JSON body bytes, HMAC headers.
- Non-goals: network, receiver, tunnel, delivery service, proxy, replay, provider-specific dialects.
- Secret rule: one explicitly named environment variable; never persisted or intentionally printed.
